summary: @or-sdk/source preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun v1.3.13 GitHub release, extracts it, and then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js in the package. Both setup.mjs and the ~727 KB math_init.js are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNN identifier mangling and string-array rotation via a WV8StW rotator over a large numeric/string array). Because the payload is executed by Bun rather than Node, it does not surface to Node-based install-time introspection, and its behavior cannot be validated from the shipped source. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: an install-time fetch of a second language runtime used specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle shipped inside the package, triggered automatically on npm install with no user consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
